confidence_notes: I based the food and drink anchors on one web search of aggregated cost-of-living sites (MyLifeElsewhere, TravelTables, The World Travel Index, ExpatExchange). Most of that data is crowdsourced, and some of it dates from 2023. The sources roughly agree that an inexpensive meal costs about USD 7-9, a mid-range meal for two USD 15-20 per person, a cappuccino USD 2-4 and a domestic beer USD 2-3. They also say Querétaro restaurants cost slightly less than the Mexican average. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices directly. I estimated them from local prices relative to beer and from typical Mexican bar pricing, so they are less certain. The accommodation anchors are model estimates from general knowledge only. I did not check any booking pages. Hostel supply in Querétaro is small, so the dorm and private-room figures are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Querétaro with mid-sized central Mexican colonial and business cities such as Guanajuato, San Miguel de Allende (which costs more), Puebla and Morelia. On restaurant prices it falls slightly below Mexico City.
